record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: For a central hyperplane arrangement A with Orlik-Solomon algebra A = E/J over the exterior algebra E, find combinatorial descriptions, at least in special cases, for the graded Betti numbers dim_C Tor_i^E(A,C)_j.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{A}=\{H_1,\dots,H_n\}$ be a central hyperplane arrangement in $\mathbb{C}^\ell$, and let $E=\bigwedge_{\mathbb{C}}\langle e_1,\dots,e_n\rangle$ be the exterior algebra on generators $e_1,\dots,e_n$ in degree $1$, with each $e_i$ corresponding to the hyperplane $H_i$. Define the Orlik–Solomon ideal $J\subset E$ as the ideal generated by all elements of the form $\partial(e_{i_1}\cdots e_{i_p})=\sum_{k=1}^{p}(-1)^{k-1}e_{i_1}\cdots\widehat{e_{i_k}}\cdots e_{i_p}$ for which the hyperplanes $H_{i_1},\dots,H_{i_p}$ are linearly dependent (equivalently, $(i_1,\dots,i_p)$ corresponds to a circuit of the underlying matroid). The Orlik–Solomon algebra is $A=E/J$, regarded as a graded $E$-module with $\mathbb{C}$ given the trivial $E$-module structure. Define the graded Betti numbers
$$\beta^E_{i,j}(A)\;=\;\dim_{\mathbb{C}}\mathrm{Tor}^E_i(A,\mathbb{C})_j.$$
Problem: Provide combinatorial descriptions, at least in interesting special families of arrangements (or matroids), of the numbers $\beta^E_{i,j}(A)$ in terms of the intersection lattice / matroid of $\mathcal{A}$.
artifact.category_tag: Orlik-Solomon algebras and graded Betti numbers
artifact.status_search_result: Partial results are known: for certain classes of matroids/arrangements, combinatorial formulas for the graded Betti numbers of the Orlik–Solomon ideal over the exterior algebra have been established (e.g., complexity, depth, regularity in terms of matroid invariants; characterizations of arrangements whose OS ideal has a linear resolution; identification of the linear strand Betti numbers with Chen ranks of the fundamental group in characteristic 0). A general combinatorial formula for all $\beta^E_{i,j}(A)$ for arbitrary central arrangements remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Homological properties of Orlik-Solomon algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Formulas for the complexity, depth and regularity of OS algebras in terms of matroid invariants; characterization of matroids whose OS ideal has a linear resolution and computation of Betti numbers in such cases.
status_evidence.claim: Partial combinatorial descriptions exist for specific classes.

status_evidence.title: arXiv:0803.0064
status_evidence.snippet: Chen ranks equal graded Betti numbers of the linear strand of the minimal free resolution of the OS algebra over the exterior algebra: theta_k(G)=dim Tor^E_{k-1}(A,k).
status_evidence.claim: Linear-strand Betti numbers have a known combinatorial/topological description.
